name: sneak
note: (anim-rework S4 keys, real-world standard, keyed by hand; never traced; M6) The stealth sneak, crouched and holstered: knees deeper (85-115 deg), the hips about 29 cm below standing and nearly level (a 2 cm bob), slow deliberate steps placed toes first and rolled flat before the weight moves onto them, the swing foot skimming low; the trunk more upright than the crouch walk (pelvis 14, chest 18 deg), the head level; the arms close to the body, elbows about 30 deg, the hands by the front of the thighs, a barely visible swing. Calculated, not exaggerated. Phase 0 is the left foot contact (toes first); keys 0-0.375 are mirrored. Angles in degrees in the body frame (x right, y up, z forward): pitch about x (+ the top forward), yaw about y (+ turns right), roll about z (+ the right side up). Pelvis offsets in cm from the standing rest (dy is the full crouch depth, so the Blender preview stands on the floor; the game adds a clip's dy to its own crouch drop: slice 4 wiring takes dy relative to the clip mean or drops the procedural crouch, S4-KEYS.md). Arms: flex (+ forward, in the chest frame: the world angle is flex minus the chest pitch), abd (+ out), elbow (+ bent), inward (the forearm turned in toward the midline); wrist (anim-rig, RIG.md) yaw / pitch / roll in the forearm frame, right hand as written, the left mirrored. Legs (the Blender preview and the track only: the game's feet come from the foot planner): flex (+ the knee forward), add (+ the foot in toward the midline), knee (+ bent), ankle (+ the toes up).
